scope: Photorealistic main-menu presentation with an animated registered portal. No native game or live Blender changes.

generation.inputs: Scene descriptions and user-supplied visual references; no logos, text, menu UI or reference pixels embedded.

composition: Realistic Greek sanctuary terrace, populated coastal city, Acropolis, jagged mountains, olive foliage, ships and weathered gateway. Scenic people/landscape are a raster plate.

portal_registration.policy: Shared cover crop/drift; source-image distance mask follows the perspective arch, projecting jambs and sloping threshold.
portal_registration.derivation: tools/calibrate_menu_portal.py: connected dark opening, threshold 28/255, signed octile distance; original artwork unchanged.

blender_scope: Separate packed 2.5D reference. Artwork is one image, with an editable registered portal mesh/procedural preview. It is not an anatomical/architectural full-scene reconstruction.
retained_sources: Prior Godot procedural scenery/bake, historical Blender city source, portal composer and original local model/texture manifests remain intact.
release_status: Generated development art; user visual acceptance and platform/minimum-device review remain pending. Existing upstream GPL/source notices retained.
